g.text: How much memory does each tool use?

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #444444

g.text: One run per question and net (n = number of runs that gave an answer). Runs at the dashed 8 GiB line ran out of memory.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #444444

g.text: About 7 MiB is the size of the measuring wrapper itself: those runs used almost nothing.
